teaser.en: Its name simply means 'heal': a woolly, scrambling herb used against spirit-caused illness.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'ponya' tu: mmea wenye sufu unaotambaa, unaotumika dhidi ya maradhi yanayosababishwa na pepo.
teaser.dg: Dzinare manage ni 'kuphoza' tu: mmea unaoambala, wenye nyere nyereru dza sufi, unaohumirwa kuphoza makongo ganayorehwa ni pepho.

summary.en: Phoza is a scrambling, white-woolly herb of the daisy family, a common Digo medicine for healing spiritual ailments. Its name means 'heal'.
summary.sw: Phoza ni mmea unaotambaa wenye sufu nyeupe, wa familia ya alizeti, dawa ya kawaida ya Wadigo ya kuponya maradhi ya kiroho. Jina lake lina maana ya 'ponya'.
summary.dg: Phoza ni mmea wa jamii ya *daisy* unaoambala, wenye nyere nyereru dza sufi, na ni dawa ya kawaida ya Adigo ya kuphoza makongo ga pepho. Dzinare manage ni 'kuphoza'.

about.en:
*Phoza* is a big, semi-succulent herb that grows as a bushy clump or scrambles over other plants, 1 to 5 metres long. Its fleshy stems are densely covered in white wool, and its large oval leaves carry cobweb-like white hairs, with stalks that wrap around the stem. The plant has an unpleasant smell.

The flowers form dense rounded masses of small yellow heads without petals, and the seeds float away on tufts of white hair. The Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw:
*Phoza* ni mmea mkubwa wenye majimaji kiasi unaoota kama kichaka kizito au kutambaa juu ya mimea mingine, wenye urefu wa mita 1 hadi 5. Mashina yake yenye nyama yamefunikwa kwa wingi na sufu nyeupe, na majani yake makubwa ya umbo la yai yana manyoya meupe kama utando wa buibui, na vikonyo vinavyozunguka shina. Mmea una harufu mbaya.

Maua hufanya mafungu mazito ya mviringo ya vichwa vidogo vya manjano visivyo na petali, na mbegu huelea mbali kwa vishungi vya manyoya meupe. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Phoza* ni mmea mkulu wa madzi-madzi chidide, unaomera dza bunda ra chitsaka au unaoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, na urewe ni kula mita 1 hadi 5. Mihiye inayonona ikafwinikpwa sana ni nyere nyereru dza sufi, na makodzage makulu ga mviringo gana nyere nyereru dza nyumba ya dzwidzwidzwi, na militaye inazunguluka muhi. Mmea una arufu mbii.

Maruwa ganamera mabunda ga mviringo ganayobanana, ga vitswa vidide vinji vya rangi ya mandano, bila vipande vya ruwa (*petals*), na tembe zinatsukulwa ni phepho kpwa mafungu ga nyere nyereru. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in thickets, forest edges and shaded bush. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vizito, pembezoni mwa misitu na vichaka vyenye kivuli. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera vitsakani, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na weruni phatu phenye chivuri-vuri. Pakia wauandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: Pakia records *phoza* as a common medicine for healing spiritual ailments. In Uganda the same species is used for malaria and children's teething problems, and as a hedge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti *phoza* kama dawa ya kawaida ya kuponya maradhi ya kiroho. Nchini Uganda spishi hiyohiyo hutumika kutibu malaria na matatizo ya watoto wanapoota meno, na pia kama ua.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika *phoza* dza dawa ya kawaida ya kuphoza makongo ga pepho. Uganda aina ihi ihi nkuhumirwa kpwa homa na shida za ana anaomera meno, na dza lichigo.

culture.en: The name is the use. *Phoza* means 'heal', and Pakia places it among names that announce the hoped-for outcome of the medicine, together with *reza*, 'neutralizer'.
culture.sw: Jina ndilo matumizi. *Phoza* lina maana ya 'ponya', na Pakia analiweka miongoni mwa majina yanayotangaza matokeo yanayotarajiwa ya dawa, pamoja na *reza*, 'kizuia/kiondoa nguvu'.
culture.dg: Dzina ndiro matumizige. *Phoza* manage ni 'kuphoza', na Pakia anariika kahi ya madzina ganayogomba vira dawa inavyotazamiwa kuhenda, phamwenga na *reza*, 'chitu cha kureza'.

names.en: Pakia records *phoza*, meaning 'heal', and gives the scientific name as *Senecio cydoniifolius*, now *Solanecio cydoniifolius*. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *phoza*, lenye maana ya 'ponya', na anatoa jina la kisayansi kama *Senecio cydoniifolius*, ambalo sasa ni *Solanecio cydoniifolius*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *phoza*, manage 'kuphoza', na analavya dzina ra chisayansi dza *Senecio cydoniifolius*, ambaro sambi ni *Solanecio cydoniifolius*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: same genus, also named for its effect
reason.sw: jenasi ileile, nao umepewa jina kutokana na athari yake
reason.dg: jenasi mwenga, piya dzinare rinagomba vira unavyohenda

reason.en: another name for a magical outcome
reason.sw: jina jingine la matokeo ya kimiujiza
reason.dg: dzina ranjina ra matokeo ga uganga
